name: com.cosmos.photon.push.thirdparty.huawei.HuaweiPushReceiver
description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK handles registration, message, status, and notification-tap events from Huawei’s legacy push channel here, forwarding tokens and background messages to the app.
disableEffect: Huawei legacy push registration, messages, and notification taps will no longer pass through MoPush.
